content.short: CryptoQuant provides on-chain and market data analytics for cryptocurrency investors.
content.description: CryptoQuant is a South Korean analytics platform that centers on a community-driven approach to help investors and market participants make data-driven decisions and manage risk in the cryptocurrency space. It provides market data, on-chain data, and a range of short- and long-term indicators for Ethereum, Bitcoin, stablecoins, and other altcoins, delivering insights that support informed investing or trading decisions in crypto markets.
